 SECTION B: PRACTICAL (15 marks)
 6. Your school is hosting a special Peace week to promote the values of harmony, unity, and
 understanding among students. As part of the celebration, you are tasked with writing a
 short message on Peace, which will be displayed around the school.
 Write the poem given below using calligraphy to be displayed during the event.
 (a) The poem should be written on plain paper measuring 21 cm × 28 cm
 (b) Ensure the letters slant at the correct angle
 (c) Create uniform ascenders and descender.
 (d) You can include an illustration relevant to the message.
 Peace is the calm in our hearts,
 A bridge that joins where conflict parts,
 It’s the light when understanding starts.
